svg.text: A mold of wells alone: only powder that starts within ~3 mm of the ring is caught
Ø40 µm powder released at random, then moving in one compiled field.
Red rings: the sites. Gold disks at the end: the powder each holds (area ∝ grains).
share of the powder on the shape (within 1 mm of it) over time
5/16 sites hold grains at the end.
Exact glass-chamber fields, 20 tones 30–70 kHz, 4× holding drive, gravity on; fallen grains are lost.
